info.title: policylinter
info.description: Command-line tool for the Azure Policy Linter. Lints Azure Policy definition files and reports authoring issues and improvement opportunities, with JSON output for CI integration.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: A linter for Azure Policy definitions that identifies issues and provides best practice recommendations.

options.name: --output
options.description: Output file path for JSON results. If not specified, results are written to console.

options.name: --list-rule-sets
options.description: List all available rule sets and exit.

options.name: --rule-set
options.description: One or more rule set names to apply. If not specified, the default rule set is applied. Use --list-rule-sets to see available sets.

arguments.name: FILES
arguments.description: Zero or more policy definition files to lint. If omitted, use --list-rule-sets to list available rule sets.
